note: The Mechanic (Bread & Butter) assembles from these — never invents components. Family context: every component must honor 'the street never shows a human name', spoon-awareness via CSS custom properties, and AAA contrast for child-facing surfaces.

Button.familyContext: Primary action. Child-facing variant must be AAA (7:1). Spoon-aware: reduce glow at low spoons.

IconButton.note: Button with icon slot — same API, aria-label required
IconButton.familyContext: Icon-only control — must carry aria-label, never an emoji-only label.

Toggle.note: Boolean switch (uses Checkbox primitive with role=switch)
Toggle.familyContext: Spoon-aware: low-spoon users need a large, forgiving toggle (>=48px touch).

Input.familyContext: Text entry. Label always visible — never placeholder-only (elder/child readability).

Select.familyContext: Choice selection. Options must be plain-language, not jargon.

Modal.familyContext: Focused dialog. Must trap focus and restore it on close — never trap a child.

Toast.familyContext: Transient notice. Spoon-aware: low-spoon users need longer auto-dismiss or no auto-dismiss.

Card.familyContext: Contained surface. Content must remain readable at AA minimum.
